testcase.name: Scenario: Collapse and expands the drawing browser tree: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:276:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Collapse and expands the drawing browser tree ✔ Given a drawing with drawing resources and a sheet is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the browser has expanded branches containing nested entries ✔ When the user opens the drawing browser menu ✔ And the user chooses Collapse All ✔ Then the drawing resources and sheet remain visible as collapsed branches ✔ And their nested entries are hidden ✔ And the drawing sheet remains visible ✔ When the user opens the drawing browser menu ✔ And the user chooses Expand All ✔ Then nested entries under the drawing resources and sheet are displayed ✔ And the drawing sheet remains visible
